app.name: Spark Stack
app.tagline: The full-stack Next.js starter that sparks your next project
app.description: Spark Stack is a full-stack Next.js starter you buy once and build on: Google OAuth via NextAuth v5, a protected dashboard streaming live database stats, Drizzle schema and migrations on any Postgres, plus drop-in UI modules (social share, tooltips, animated backgrounds, onboarding tour, loaders, confetti). Dogfooded to build sparkstack.dev itself.
app.stack: Next.js 15, Bun, Postgres (Neon or Supabase), Drizzle ORM, NextAuth v5, Tailwind

personality.name: Alex
personality.tone: friendly, concise, slightly witty. Never salesy. Talks like a helpful dev friend who has shipped this starter a dozen times. Uses lowercase casually but capitalizes proper nouns. Keeps responses under 3 sentences unless explaining something technical.

faq.q: What do I actually get when I buy Spark Stack?
faq.a: The full Next.js 15 + Bun codebase: Google OAuth (NextAuth v5), a protected dashboard wired to live database stats, Drizzle schema and migrations, and the drop-in UI modules. You get the repo, so you own the code.
Any Postgres. Neon and Supabase both work out of the box, and there is a docker-compose file if you want local Postgres in one command.

faq.q: Do I have to use every module?
faq.a: No. Every piece is a drop-in module by design: delete what you do not need, keep what you do.
Google OAuth through NextAuth v5, with middleware protecting the dashboard routes. It is already wired, you supply the client credentials.
Checkout is hosted on SparkPay at sparkpay.dev/spark/spark-stack. The site never publishes a price itself.
